author: 작자미상
description_zh: 朝鲜时代最著名的爱情故事，讲述官妓之女春香与贵族子弟李梦龙的爱情。
description_en: The most famous love story of the Joseon era, about the love between Chunhyang and nobleman Lee Mongryong.

author: 작자미상
description_zh: 讲述孝女沈清为使盲父重见光明而投海的感人故事。
description_en: The touching story of filial daughter Simcheong who sacrifices herself for her blind father.

author: 작자미상
description_zh: 善良的弟弟兴夫与贪婪的哥哥孬夫的因果报应故事。
description_en: A tale of karmic retribution between kind brother Heungbu and greedy brother Nolbu.

title_english: The Cloud Dream of the Nine
author: 김만중
description_zh: 佛门弟子性真的尘世轮回梦，探讨人生虚幻与觉悟。
description_en: The worldly reincarnation dream of Buddhist disciple Seong-jin, exploring illusion and enlightenment.

author: 허균
description_zh: 朝鲜最早的韩文小说，讲述庶子洪吉童反抗不公的故事。
description_en: The first Korean novel, about illegitimate son Hong Gildong's rebellion against injustice.

author: 작자미상
description_zh: 龙王派鳖到陆地求兔肝的寓言故事，讽刺权贵。
description_en: A fable about a turtle sent by the Dragon King to fetch a rabbit's liver, satirizing the powerful.

author: 이광수
description_zh: 韩国最早的现代长篇小说，描写新旧思想冲突中的爱情纠葛。
description_en: Korea's first modern novel, depicting love entanglements amid the conflict between old and new ideas.

author: 심훈
description_zh: 描写青年知识分子投身农村启蒙运动的理想与奋斗。
description_en: Depicting young intellectuals' ideals and struggles in rural enlightenment movements.

author: 이상
description_zh: 韩国现代主义文学代表作，以意识流手法描写知识分子的迷茫。
description_en: A masterpiece of Korean modernism, depicting intellectual confusion through stream of consciousness.

author: 조정래
description_zh: 描写韩国现代史上分裂与战争的史诗巨作。
description_en: An epic depicting division and war in modern Korean history.

author: 최인훈
description_zh: 描写在南北分裂中寻找精神归属的知识分子的苦恼。
description_en: Depicting an intellectual's anguish in seeking spiritual belonging amid North-South division.

title_english: A Dwarf Launches a Little Ball
author: 조세희
description_zh: 描写韩国产业化时期底层劳动者的苦难与挣扎。
description_en: Depicting the suffering and struggles of lower-class workers during Korea's industrialization.

author: 이문열
description_zh: 以小学教室为舞台的权力寓言，影射独裁政治。
description_en: A power allegory set in an elementary classroom, alluding to dictatorship.

author: 황석영
description_zh: 描写流浪劳动者返乡之路的迷惘与乡愁。
description_en: Depicting the confusion and nostalgia of wandering laborers on their way home.

author: 황석영
description_zh: 描写建筑工地劳动者的艰苦生活与团结抗争。
description_en: Depicting the hard life and solidarity of construction site workers.

author: वाल्मीकि
description_zh: 印度两大史诗之一，讲述罗摩王子营救妻子悉多的故事。
description_en: One of India's two great epics, telling of Prince Rama's quest to rescue his wife Sita.

author: व्यास
description_zh: 世界最长史诗，讲述俱卢与般度两族的战争故事。
description_en: The world's longest epic, telling the war between the Kaurava and Pandava dynasties.

author: व्यास
description_zh: 《摩诃婆罗多》中最神圣的部分，克里希纳对阿周那的教诲。
description_en: The most sacred part of Mahabharata, Krishna's teachings to Arjuna.

author: विष्णुशर्मा
description_zh: 印度最著名的寓言故事集，以动物为主角传授处世智慧。
description_en: India's most famous fable collection, teaching worldly wisdom through animal characters.

author: रवीन्द्रनाथ टैगोर
description_zh: 泰戈尔获诺贝尔文学奖的诗集，充满对神性与自然的赞美。
description_en: Tagore's Nobel Prize-winning poetry collection, full of praise for divinity and nature.

author: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর
description_zh: 探讨印度民族主义与宗教认同的长篇小说。
description_en: A novel exploring Indian nationalism and religious identity.

author: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর
description_zh: 探讨印度民族独立运动中个人与国家关系的小说。
description_en: A novel exploring the relationship between individual and nation during India's independence movement.

author: E. M. Forster
description_zh: 描写英属印度时期英印关系的经典小说。
description_en: A classic novel depicting British-Indian relations during the Raj.

author: R. K. Narayan
description_zh: 讲述导游拉朱从骗子到圣人的讽刺性转变。
description_en: The satirical transformation of guide Raju from con man to saint.

author: Salman Rushdie
description_zh: 以印度独立为背景的魔幻现实主义史诗，布克奖获奖作品。
description_en: A magical realist epic set against Indian independence, Booker Prize winner.

author: Gregory David Roberts
description_zh: 澳大利亚逃犯在孟买贫民窟的传奇经历。
description_en: The legendary experiences of an Australian fugitive in Mumbai's slums.

author: Rohinton Mistry
description_zh: 描写紧急状态时期印度底层人民的苦难与韧性。
description_en: Depicting the suffering and resilience of India's underclass during the Emergency.

author: Suketu Mehta
description_zh: 深入探索孟买这座
的方方面面。
description_en: An in-depth exploration of Mumbai, the 'maximum city'.

author: Rohinton Mistry
description_zh: 以1971年印巴战争为背景的帕西人家庭故事。
description_en: A Parsi family story set against the 1971 India-Pakistan war.

author: Aravind Adiga
description_zh: 讲述底层青年巴尔拉姆通过犯罪实现阶层跃升的故事。
description_en: The story of lower-class youth Balram's rise through crime.

author: বিভূতিভূষণ বন্দ্যোপাধ্যায়
description_zh: 描写孟加拉乡村少年阿普成长历程的经典小说。
description_en: A classic novel depicting the coming-of-age of Bengali village boy Apu.

author: রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর
description_zh: 探讨印度寡妇命运与女性情欲的争议性小说。
description_en: A controversial novel exploring the fate of Indian widows and female desire.

author: শরৎচন্দ্র চট্টোপাধ্যায়
description_zh: 印度最著名的爱情悲剧，描写德夫达斯与帕罗的悲恋。
description_en: India's most famous tragic romance between Devdas and Paro.

author: শরৎচন্দ্র চট্টোপাধ্যায়
description_zh: 描写两个邻居家庭之间的爱情与误解。
description_en: Depicting love and misunderstanding between two neighboring families.

author: Amitav Ghosh
description_zh: 以孙德尔本斯红树林为背景的生态与人文故事。
description_en: An ecological and human story set in the Sundarbans mangrove forest.

author: तुलसीदास
description_zh: 杜勒西达斯用阿瓦提语改写的罗摩衍那，印度北部最受欢迎的宗教文本。
description_en: Tulsidas's Awadhi retelling of Ramayana, North India's most beloved religious text.

author: कबीर
description_zh: 印度神秘主义诗人卡比尔的双行诗，融合印度教与伊斯兰教思想。
description_en: Couplets by mystic poet Kabir, blending Hindu and Islamic thought.

author: प्रेमचंद
description_zh: 普列姆昌德的代表作，描写印度农民霍里的悲惨命运。
description_en: Premchand's masterpiece depicting the tragic fate of Indian farmer Hori.

author: प्रेमचंद
description_zh: 探讨嫁妆制度和童婚问题的社会小说。
description_en: A social novel exploring the dowry system and child marriage.

author: प्रेमचंद
description_zh: 描写女性被迫沦为妓女的社会悲剧。
description_en: A social tragedy depicting women forced into prostitution.

title_original: สี่แผ่นดิน
author: คึกฤทธิ์ ปราโมช
description_zh: 描写跨越四个泰王朝的宫廷女性的一生。
description_en: Depicting the life of a court lady spanning four Thai reigns.

title_original: ข้างหลังภาพ
author: ศรีบูรพา
description_zh: 泰国最著名的爱情小说，描写年轻学生与贵妇的禁忌之恋。
description_en: Thailand's most famous romance, depicting forbidden love between a young student and a noblewoman.

author: คำพูน บุญทวี
description_zh: 描写泰国东北部农村孩子成长的生动故事。
description_en: A vivid story of growing up in rural northeastern Thailand.

title_original: ผู้ชนะสิบทิศ
author: ยาขอบ
description_zh: 以缅甸入侵泰国为背景的历史冒险小说。
description_en: A historical adventure novel set during the Burmese invasion of Thailand.

title_original: มนต์รักลูกทุ่ง
author: รพีพร
description_zh: 泰国乡村爱情故事的经典之作。
description_en: A classic Thai rural love story.

author: Nguyễn Du
description_zh: 越南最伟大的文学作品，描写才女翠翘的坎坷命运。
description_en: Vietnam's greatest literary work, depicting the tragic fate of talented beauty Kieu.

author: Đặng Trần Côn
description_zh: 越南古典文学名作，描写思妇对远征丈夫的思念。
description_en: A Vietnamese classic depicting a wife's longing for her soldier husband at war.

author: Vũ Trọng Phụng
description_zh: 越南现代文学经典，讽刺殖民时期上流社会的虚伪。
description_en: A Vietnamese modern classic satirizing the hypocrisy of colonial-era high society.

author: Tô Hoài
description_zh: 描写越南少数民族青年反抗封建压迫的故事。
description_en: A story of Vietnamese minority youth rebelling against feudal oppression.

author: Tô Hoài
description_zh: 越南最著名的儿童文学作品，讲述蟋蟀德绵的冒险故事。
description_en: Vietnam's most famous children's book, about the adventures of a cricket.

author: José Rizal
description_zh: 菲律宾民族英雄黎萨尔的代表作，揭露西班牙殖民统治的罪恶。
description_en: Philippine national hero Rizal's masterpiece exposing the evils of Spanish colonial rule.

author: José Rizal
description_zh: 《不许犯我》的续集，更加激烈地批判殖民统治。
description_en: Sequel to 'Noli Me Tangere', more intensely criticizing colonial rule.

author: Francisco Balagtas
description_zh: 菲律宾文学经典，以古代阿尔巴尼亚为背景的爱情史诗。
description_en: A Philippine classic, a love epic set in ancient Albania.

author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer
description_zh: 印尼最重要的现代小说，描写殖民时期爪哇青年的觉醒。
description_en: Indonesia's most important modern novel, depicting a Javanese youth's awakening during colonialism.

author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer
description_zh: 布鲁四部曲第二部，继续探讨殖民地觉醒主题。
description_en: Second in the Buru Quartet, continuing to explore colonial awakening themes.

author: Marah Rusli
description_zh: 印尼现代文学开山之作，批判包办婚姻制度。
description_en: A pioneering work of modern Indonesian literature, criticizing arranged marriage.

author: Sutan Takdir Alisjahbana
description_zh: 探讨印尼女性解放与现代化的先锋小说。
description_en: A pioneering novel exploring Indonesian women's liberation and modernization.

author: Andrea Hirata
description_zh: 印尼最畅销的小说，讲述贫困学生追求教育的感人故事。
description_en: Indonesia's best-selling novel, a touching story of poor students pursuing education.

author: فردوسی
description_zh: 波斯民族史诗，记录波斯从创世到伊斯兰征服的神话与历史。
description_en: The Persian national epic, recording myths and history from creation to the Islamic conquest.

author: جلال‌الدین محمد رومی
description_zh: 鲁米的苏非主义诗歌杰作，被称为
description_en: Rumi's Sufi poetry masterpiece, called 'the Quran in Persian'.

author: حافظ
description_zh: 波斯最伟大的抒情诗人哈菲兹的诗集。
description_en: The collected poems of Hafez, Persia's greatest lyric poet.

author: صادق هدایت
description_zh: 伊朗现代文学最重要的作品，充满超现实与存在主义色彩。
description_en: The most important work of modern Iranian literature, full of surrealism and existentialism.

author: محمود دولت‌آبادی
description_zh: 伊朗最长的小说，描写库尔德农民的生活与斗争。
description_en: Iran's longest novel, depicting the life and struggles of Kurdish peasants.

author: سیمین دانشور
description_zh: 伊朗女性作家的第一部波斯语长篇小说，以二战时期设拉子为背景。
description_en: The first Persian novel by an Iranian woman, set in Shiraz during WWII.

author: جمال میرصادقی
description_zh: 描写德黑兰中产家庭的社会变迁。
description_en: Depicting social changes in a Tehran middle-class family.

author: Marjane Satrapi
description_zh: 以图像小说形式讲述伊朗伊斯兰革命中女孩的成长故事。
description_en: A graphic novel memoir of a girl growing up during the Iranian Islamic Revolution.

author: Azar Nafisi
description_zh: 伊朗女教授在德黑兰秘密读书会的回忆录。
description_en: Memoir of an Iranian professor's secret reading group in Tehran.

author: Khaled Hosseini
description_zh: 阿富汗裔美国作家的成名作，描写阿富汗两个男孩的友谊与背叛。
description_en: Afghan-American author's breakthrough novel about friendship and betrayal between two Afghan boys.

author: سعدی
description_zh: 萨迪的散文杰作，以故事和格言传授人生智慧。
description_en: Saadi's prose masterpiece, teaching life wisdom through stories and maxims.

author: سعدی
description_zh: 萨迪的诗歌杰作，以韵文形式传授道德与智慧。
description_en: Saadi's poetic masterpiece, teaching morality and wisdom in verse.

author: عمر خیام
description_zh: 奥马尔·海亚姆的四行诗集，充满享乐主义与怀疑精神。
description_en: Omar Khayyam's quatrains, full of hedonism and skepticism.

author: فریدالدین عطار
description_zh: 苏非派诗人阿塔尔的寓言诗，以群鸟寻找凤凰象征灵魂追求神性。
description_en: Sufi poet Attar's allegorical poem about birds seeking the Simurgh, symbolizing the soul's quest for the divine.

author: نظامی گنجوی
description_zh: 波斯最著名的爱情故事，讲述少年盖斯对蕾拉的疯狂之爱。
description_en: Persia's most famous love story, about young Qays's mad love for Layla.

author: نظامی گنجوی
description_zh: 尼扎米五韵诗之一，讲述波斯国王巴赫拉姆五世与七位公主的故事。
description_en: One of Nizami's five poems, telling of King Bahram V and seven princesses.

author: نظامی گنجوی
description_zh: 波斯王霍斯劳与亚美尼亚公主希琳的爱情史诗。
description_en: The love epic of Persian King Khosrow and Armenian princess Shirin.

author: جلال آل‌احمد
description_zh: 描写伊斯法罕这座
的历史与文化的游记。
description_en: A travelogue describing the history and culture of Isfahan, 'Half of the World'.

author: جلال آل‌احمد
description_zh: 批判伊朗盲目西化的著名论文，对伊朗伊斯兰革命有深远影响。
description_en: Famous critique of Iran's blind Westernization, deeply influential on the Islamic Revolution.

author: فرامرز خداداد
description_zh: 中世纪波斯散文史诗，讲述侠客萨马克的冒险故事。
description_en: Medieval Persian prose epic about the adventures of the knight-errant Samak.

author: مؤلف مجهول
description_zh: 世界最著名的故事集之一，包括阿拉丁、辛巴达等经典故事。
description_en: One of the world's most famous story collections, including Aladdin, Sinbad, and more.

author: الحريري
description_zh: 阿拉伯文学中最精妙的韵文故事集。
description_en: The most sophisticated collection of rhymed prose tales in Arabic literature.

author: ابن المقفع
description_zh: 从印度《五卷书》翻译改编的阿拉伯寓言集。
description_en: Arabic fable collection translated and adapted from Indian Panchatantra.

title_english: The Palm Tree and the Neighbors
author: غائب طعمة فرمان
description_zh: 描写巴格达贫民区生活的伊拉克现代小说经典。
description_en: A classic Iraqi modern novel depicting life in Baghdad's poor neighborhoods.

title_english: Season of Migration to the North
author: الطيب صالح
description_zh: 阿拉伯文学中最重要的后殖民小说之一。
description_en: One of the most important postcolonial novels in Arabic literature.

author: نجيب محفوظ
description_zh: 马哈福兹争议性的寓言小说，以街区故事隐喻宗教历史。
description_en: Mahfouz's controversial allegorical novel, using neighborhood stories to represent religious history.

author: نجيب محفوظ
description_zh: 马哈福兹的诺贝尔文学奖代表作，描写开罗一个家庭三代人的变迁。
description_en: Mahfouz's Nobel Prize-winning masterpiece, depicting three generations of a Cairo family.

author: نجيب محفوظ
description_zh: 描写开罗老城小巷中各色人物的生活与梦想。
description_en: Depicting the lives and dreams of various characters in an old Cairo alley.

author: نجيب محفوظ
description_zh: 马哈福兹现代主义小说代表作，探讨背叛与复仇。
description_en: Mahfouz's modernist masterpiece exploring betrayal and revenge.

title_english: The Diary of a Country Prosecutor
author: توفيق الحكيم
description_zh: 埃及著名剧作家的讽刺小说，描写乡村司法的荒谬。
description_en: A satirical novel by Egypt's famous playwright depicting the absurdity of rural justice.

author: توفيق الحكيم
description_zh: 描写埃及青年在巴黎留学经历的自传体小说。
description_en: An autobiographical novel about an Egyptian youth's studies in Paris.

author: طه حسين
description_zh: 阿拉伯现代文学之父的自传，描写盲人求学的艰辛历程。
description_en: Autobiography of the father of modern Arabic literature, describing a blind man's quest for education.

author: طه حسين
description_zh: 描写埃及乡村女性悲剧命运的小说。
description_en: A novel depicting the tragic fate of women in rural Egypt.

author: علاء الأسواني
description_zh: 以开罗一栋公寓楼为舞台，描写当代埃及社会众生相。
description_en: Using a Cairo apartment building as a stage to depict contemporary Egyptian society.

author: محمد حسنين هيكل
description_zh: 关于萨达特总统被暗杀前后埃及政治的权威记录。
description_en: An authoritative account of Egyptian politics around President Sadat's assassination.

author: Lawrence Durrell
description_zh: 以二战前亚历山大港为背景的现代主义四部曲。
description_en: A modernist tetralogy set in pre-WWII Alexandria.

author: Κωνσταντίνος Καβάφης
description_zh: 亚历山大港希腊诗人卡瓦菲斯的诗集，探讨历史与情欲。
description_en: Poetry collection of Alexandrian Greek poet Cavafy, exploring history and desire.

author: إبراهيم عبدالمجيد
description_zh: 描写当代亚历山大港底层生活的小说。
description_en: A novel depicting lower-class life in contemporary Alexandria.

author: إبراهيم عبدالمجيد
description_zh: 以二战时期亚历山大港为背景的历史小说。
description_en: A historical novel set in WWII-era Alexandria.

author: إبراهيم عبدالمجيد
description_zh: 亚历山大三部曲的最后一部，描写城市的衰落。
description_en: The final part of the Alexandria trilogy, depicting the city's decline.

author: מחברים שונים
description_zh: 犹太教圣经，包括律法书、先知书和圣文集。
description_en: The Jewish Bible, including the Torah, Prophets, and Writings.

author: חז"ל
description_zh: 塔木德中的阿加达部分，包含丰富的传说与智慧。
description_en: The Aggadah portions of the Talmud, containing rich legends and wisdom.
